movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Knock Off
movelist.effect: Choose one of the target’s Held Items or Accessory Slot Items. It is knocked to the ground.

movelist.name: Bug Bite
movelist.effect: If the target has a stored Digestion Buff or has traded in a Digestion Buff this Scene, the user may gain the effects of the Digestion Buff. This does not count towards the usual limit on the user’s Digestion Buffs.

movelist.name: Acupressure
movelist.effect: Roll 1d6. On a result of 1, raise the target’s Attack 2 Combat Stages. On a result of 2, raise the target’s Defense 2 Combat Stages. On a result of 3, raise the target’s Special Attack 2 Combat Stages. On a result of 4, raise the target’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages. On a result of 5, raise the target’s Speed 2 Combat Stages. On a result of 6, raise the target’s Accuracy by +2.

abilities.name: Sniper
abilities.effect: When the user gets a Critical Hit, the attack deals +3d10 additional damage.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.effect: The user’s Accuracy cannot be lowered, their attacks cannot have Accuracy Penalties (such as from Illuminate), the user is immune to the Blind condition (but not Total Blindness), and the user ignores any Evasion not directly derived from Stats (such as from the Instinct Ability, or from moves like Minimize).
